scope: 35 exact historical relationship keys outside the other reviewers’ assigned sets. Exact old endpoint meanings and stances inspected, reusing only byte-identical repeated text. Source pages 252 and 268 re-read in full to resolve the constitutional-demand and committee-of-justice claims.

rows.review_disposition: CC141 can internalize the Committee’s evolving authority and later statutory centralization. Preserve April creation, July reconstitution and December hierarchy as different stages, with initially contested and delayed control.

Committee formation is a component of emergency expansion, but the full umbrella also contains conscription, justice and controls. Retain those separate functions; CC141 must not imply that one institution alone constituted the entire response.

488D must retain Desmoulins and the Vieux Cordelier as the public voice of indulgence, Robespierre’s initial blessing and subsequent withdrawal, and criticism of wrongful detention and dechristianization. Internalization is appropriate with named access.
BBD must preserve federalism as a polemical label distinct from the mostly republican aims and opportunistic royalist participation. Do not make decentralization equivalent to national dissolution.

Retire the projected general crisis edge, but preserve foreign danger prompting the February levy in C79 and distinguish it from August mass mobilization in 81DD. Internal resistance was both an effect of conscription and an aggravation of the wider crisis.

CC141 can internalize watch committees as an emergency institution on 227. Preserve their later survival and certificate/suspect functions rather than treating creation and centralization as simultaneous.

CC141 must explicitly attribute the revolutionary/constitutional-government justification to Robespierre and preserve its wartime founding-versus-peacetime-preserving distinction. This is an argument, not a neutral definition.

8A64 can internalize the Maximum as a basis for partial stabilization. Preserve temporary assignat recovery, black markets and incomplete enforcement; neither total success nor complete failure matches the source.
E57 can internalize design preceding ratification and suspension. Preserve democratic provisions and political legitimation separately from nonimplementation.

8A64 must preserve wage ceilings alienating workers before Thermidor and lower rates afterward. Post-coup rates cannot explain earlier refusal to defend Robespierre; qualify chronology rather than blending both effects.

Reject implemented_by if it implies enactment of the democratic constitution. CC141 may retain emergency government following suspension, with the old predicate expressly corrected rather than supposedly preserved verbatim.

Retire the repeated Toulon membership edge, preserving local causes, the limited network of coordination and its later exceptional foreign/royalist turn. A category alone must not erase delegates and uneven coordination.
2319 preserves abolition accelerating paper collapse through market procurement, revenue weakness and additional issues on 286–287. Keep the qualified contributory direction.

1D983 must retain Verona closing negotiated restoration and thereby leaving force as the remaining strategy in Doyle’s account. Do not invent an abstract node or assert that the declaration originated all earlier armed counter-revolution.
Toulon’s local anti-Jacobin backlash is substantive parent content. Retire the broad universal cause edge only with property fears, restored sections and the actual local coalition preserved.

BBD can internalize the extent qualification from eligible prose on 241/243: exaggerated department totals coexist with the danger posed by major cities. Excluded map interiors cannot supply the factual extent.

Recruitment failure explains the limit of federalist strategic threat, not the absence of danger. BBD must retain reluctance to leave home, limited forces and failure to reach Paris alongside the importance of major cities.
60DA must retain local town-country hostility among the Vendée’s multiple causes. Page 229’s Marseilles hinterland belongs elsewhere and must not be copied as Vendéan evidence.
8A64 can internalize controls contributing to temporary stabilization on 265, with evasion, administration and preferential military purchasing explicit.

CC141 must preserve external and internal crisis driving emergency expansion before the fully organized system existed. Do not reduce the whole crisis to an administrative label or retrospectively justify every later execution.
BBD can internalize the connection between property/economic grievances and local anti-Jacobin backlash, with cross-class coalitions and variation by city explicit.
DFDC can retain Bonaparte’s tactical role at Toulon on 254. Preserve his artillery plan within the wider siege and do not turn later prominence into predestined ascent.
8B56 must retain Puisaye’s expedition promises and rebels’ tactical use of peace on 290. Generous concessions alone did not explain apparent compliance.
60DA can internalize the Vendée as a particular town-country conflict, with recruitment, religion, property and local officials distinguished. It is not a universal template for provincial revolt.

488D must retain engineered trial procedure, curtailed defense and expulsion of defendants on 274–275. Preserve the weakness of a demonstrated current conspiracy and the distinction between alleged corruption and actual charges.

8A64 can internalize anti-hoarding coercion enforcing controls. Preserve criminalization, suspect status and armed provisioning as specific mechanisms rather than asserting that accusations proved hoarding caused all shortages.
488D can internalize Danton’s association with clemency, but retain loose alignment, compromised associates and his earlier support for emergency coercion. The group was not a uniform innocent party.
CC141 must retain districts/communes as executors, national agents as monitors and departments’ residual routine functions. Centralization did not abolish all local administration.

7549 can internalize named Companies of the Sun and Jesus with partly royalist and regionally variable motives. Preserve broader revenge violence and avoid attributing all White Terror to a single royalist organization.
BBD must retain military weakness limiting an otherwise serious regional challenge. Internalization is sound with weak recruitment and reluctance to fight away from home explicit.

Page 268 directly supports the committee of justice, its proposed wrongful-arrest review and rapid abolition. Retain Robespierre’s temporary support and the fragility of restraint inside 488D, not merely a generic indulgence label.

Author retirement is incomplete. Full page 252 explicitly says suppression silenced Enragé calls to activate the constitution. Preserve this specific political effect in FEC/E57, while rejecting the normalized positive supports direction and any claim that suppression alone caused suspension.

8A64 can retain scarcity and provisioning distress motivating punitive policy, with contemporary accusation separated from established economic explanation and local enforcement from nationwide design.
Hoche’s conciliation contributed to western agreements, with military pressure and tactical rebel calculations also preserved. 8B56 should not suggest permanent reconciliation.

8A64 can internalize wage ceilings as a component of the General Maximum while preserving their initial non-enforcement and dependence on wage earners. Price and wage controls did not operate equally.
